name: Wayfinder
author: Tom Ballard
description: Native AI model routing with in-panel setup, project profiles, status, and controls for Omarchy.

barWidget.description: First-run setup, repository profiles, gateway health, routes, readiness, savings, and service controls.

schema.label: Gateway endpoint
schema.description: The Wayfinder gateway base URL. Credentials must not be included.

schema.label: Router config
schema.description: Optional path passed to service installation. Leave empty for Wayfinder discovery.

schema.label: Repository root
schema.description: Optional local Git repository managed by the project-profile panel. Wayfinder never edits it.
